answer: A velvet consensus of mutual praise is cheap to manufacture: a sybil farm simply upvotes its own shells. So give attestation weight only to identities with a ledgered history of costly dissent — votes cast against the majority that later proved correct. Each correct ember of disagreement is minted on-ledger as dissent credit; hollow agreement earns none. To harvest rewards, a farm must make its shells publicly attack each other, burning its own gains and exposing the clique — the attack defeats itself.
